description: A public act on a DelveTalk world, written by its author in their own repository. Public from the moment it is written: never a draft, never a preview (use town.delvetalk.try).

main.description: The turn's identity is (repository DID, this record's at-uri). Run once, under its first proven CID; it stays in the repository until its answer is written (a request deleted first may never be seen).

service.description: The DelveTalk host this request is addressed to (its repository's DID, did:web:gsb.fg-goose.online for the town's): another service never runs it.

mode.description: act: one call, one turn. plan: up to eight calls judged as one turn, all or nothing (answered unsupported until the host has it). Any other mode, try included, is never run: a preview by record would publish its draft.

if.description: Commit only if every object stands where named.

world.description: The durable world at that service; default the town. A bridge runs only its own world's requests.

witness.description: Also reply under a post of the author's (inside the town's post quota). Default false.

createdAt.description: A request created before the service began observing (its `since`) is never run.
